name: A stated range is a range, not a point
note: Incident (fixed 2026-09-08): '$8M-$10M' collapsed to a single point instead of a min/max band, so the size dimension judged every lender against one number. A lender whose window opens at $9M contradicts a point at $8M but serves an $8-10M deal — the shortlist dropped valid funders for a range a user actually typed. Both ends must survive the parse.
